Definition
[Hölder space $C^{m,\alpha }$]

Source: petersen:page-0419 ↗ def:pet-ch11-cm-norm ↗ def:pet-ch11-holder-pseudonorm Define the Hölder space $C^{m,\alpha }(\Omega ,\mathbb {R}^k)$ as those $u\in C^m(\Omega ,\mathbb {R}^k)$ whose $m$th-order partial derivatives all have finite $C^\alpha $ pseudo-norm, with norm \[ \| u\| _{C^{m,\alpha }}=\| u\| _{C^m}+\sum _{|I|=m}\| \partial ^Iu\| _\alpha . \] If the domain needs to be specified, one writes $\| u\| _{C^{m,\alpha },\Omega }$.
